cells.gaps: No rule in force requiring accessible public information or digital services is found. No source found since October 2023 gives the results of an accessibility audit of public websites or digital services.
cells.note: In July 2025 the Department of Basic Education reported that 406 of 461 public special schools had received ICT equipment and assistive devices under ICASA obligations. Stage 5 needs a published audit, and none is found.
